whatsapp_text: Hi, I'd like to discuss receivables ageing software for our collections.
persona: Owner or accounts head of a distributor whose cash is stuck in overdue invoices

sections.h2: What an ageing view is for
paras: Receivables ageing sorts every unpaid invoice by how long it has been outstanding and groups it into buckets, so a balance that is a week old is never confused with one that is five months old. The total owed is a number your accountant already has. The ageing is what tells you which part of it is still normal trade credit and which part is a problem.

Aura Business holds this in the Finance and Accounting suite, fed directly by the invoices raised in the billing suite and the receipts entered against them. Because invoices, receipts, customer credit terms and the WhatsApp reminder run through the same system, the ageing view is also a working list: you can open the customer, see every open invoice, and act on it.

sections.h2: Everyone knows the total outstanding. Almost nobody knows the shape of it.
sections.lead: A distributor with healthy sales and bad collections is a distributor that runs out of cash while looking profitable.

items.p: The outstanding figure is known to the rupee and nobody can say how much of it is over ninety days.
The customer who calls gets attention, while the quiet one with the oldest balance is never rung.
Payments arrive as bulk transfers and are never matched to specific invoices, so the ledger drifts.
A customer already past their agreed limit is despatched to again because the limit lives in someone's head.
Three people chase the same customer and none of them knows what the last one was told.
An invoice was never going to be paid because of a short delivery, and nobody found out for a quarter.

sections.h2: From invoice raised to money in the bank.

steps.p: The GST tax invoice enters the customer ledger with its date and due date.
The customer's credit days set when the invoice becomes overdue, not a general rule.
The open balance falls into a bucket and moves along as it ages.
The desk works down by age and value, not by who telephoned.
An automated WhatsApp reminder goes out on the schedule you set.
Payment matched against specific invoices, and the ledger and ageing update.
A disputed invoice is flagged and settled by credit note rather than sitting in the bucket.

items.q: Can we set our own ageing buckets?
items.a: Yes. The bucket boundaries are configured to match how your business thinks about credit, because a distributor selling to government hospitals has a very different sense of normal from one selling to private clinics.

items.q: Does it replace our accounting software?
items.a: No. It manages invoicing, receipts, ageing and collections. Your accountant keeps the books, using the Tally or accounting export and the GST returns prep. See GST billing.

Each customer carries a credit limit and credit days. The credit days set the due date on their invoices, and an order that would take the customer past the limit is flagged for a decision before despatch.

items.q: Can one payment settle several invoices?
items.a: Yes. A receipt can be applied across multiple open invoices, wholly or partly, so a bulk transfer from a hospital leaves the ledger accurate rather than sitting as an unallocated credit.

items.q: Are AMC instalments included in the ageing?
items.a: Yes. Contract instalments, product invoices and service invoices are all invoices, so they age together and appear in the same customer balance. See AMC billing.
Yes. Outstanding reminders can be sent on a schedule over WhatsApp and stop when the invoice is settled. See WhatsApp payment reminders.
